headline: GTL Infrastructure holds 23rd Annual General Meeting
summary: GTL Infrastructure Limited has announced the completion of its 23rd Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company submitted the meeting proceedings to the stock exchanges as per regulatory requirements. Retail investors in the company track such statutory meetings for management updates and voting outcomes on routine resolutions.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on stock price

headline: GTL Infrastructure files scrutinizer report for annual general meeting
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: GTL Infrastructure has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This regulatory filing concludes the procedural requirements following the company's recent shareholder meeting. Retail investors should note this is standard corporate governance compliance with no direct impact on the company's financial position.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no financial impact on your holdings
